about: Does dark mode save battery? Factory #31, backlog row 35, slug darkmode. One hard idea: dark mode only saves power on OLED screens, where every pixel is its own light and black pixels switch off; on LCD screens a backlight stays on even for black. Even on OLED, the saving depends on brightness: Purdue (Dash & Hu, MobiSys 2021) found 3%-9% at 30%-50% brightness and 39%-47% at 100%. Viewer check: in a dark room, a black photo glows gray on LCD and is pitch black on OLED. Sources (read 2026-11-14) in BRIEF.md section 3. Planned silences: 0.5 s after the hook (frame-0 hit), 0.6 s after 'switch it off.' (dip: the needle doesn't move), 0.5 s after 'three to nine percent.' (needle tick), 1.2 s after 'forty-seven percent.' (hero: meter needle slams to the 39-47 band, screenshot hold). Narration-led: record the voice first and key every visual beat to its word times. Director 2026-11-14: `at` re-chained to the real Ming takes (last word + the planned pause, or take tail + 0.15 s where the take rings longer); dur = last word + 0.4 s. Jury r1 (2026-11-14): sun pause 1.7 s (hero hold), end line moved 0.5 s later, 'black screen glow' for clarity, tail_fade 0.15 on the end take.

lines.text: Dark mode doesn't always save battery.
So does dark mode save battery on your phone?
Turn off the lights and open a black photo.
If the black glows gray, that's an LCD screen.
